neighbours.label: a verb or clause boundary where someone offers input on something (an opinion, a suggestion, a correction, reporting an error), as against the same verbs used for ordinary physical actions
fire: During the review, Maria spoke up and offered her thoughts on the budget.
If you spot a typo on this page, please email the editor.
Readers are welcome to suggest corrections or new topics.
He skimmed the proposal and added what he felt was lacking.
If you believe this listing is wrong, contact our support team.
My colleague often interrupts to correct my figures in meetings.
Customers can propose new features through the feedback form.
Should you find an error in the invoice, tell us within ten days.
quiet: During the break, Maria walked over and offered her guests some tea.
If you spot a fox in the garden, keep the cat indoors.
Readers are welcome to borrow up to six books at a time.
He skimmed the proposal and left the office at five.
If you believe in ghosts, this castle tour is for you.
My colleague often interrupts to ask for more coffee in meetings.
Customers can pay for new features through the online shop.
Should you find a wallet in the taxi, hand it to the driver.
